notes.content: The page asks how much of the relation structure can be recovered from particular relations. Item b states characterizations of parallel/disjointness using ≤ or ≪ and records a checking note on (1.24)b. Item c characterizes the curved order using ≪ and the same parallel partners. Item d identifies the nonempty minimal elements for ≪ as lieux. An abandoned compatibility characterization is canceled. The author then says he does not see how ≪, even with the curved order, determines ≤ or compatibility, before asserting a relation between ≤, ≪ and compatibility in the final (1.27). The exact last arrow remains graphically ambiguous. The page ends mid-transition.
notes.math_reading_decisions: Ink alone fixed all symbols. In particular, Inf in (1.24)b is followed by bare F,G; the two early empty-set subscripts are plain F; family-alphabet uncertainty begins in NB; (1.25) preserves the older ≤ and canceled H|K; and the abandoned formula stops after an opening brace and an unbarred V.
